scheduler_tick_cadence.reason: each probe applies one explicit P-Bus clock event at scheduler tick 2; scheduler ticks order external events and are not elapsed-time units

search_methods.claim: The startup EIC initializer unmasks these nine channels.
search_methods.pattern: stores to EIC control words with EIMK bit 7 clear in startup initializer 0x62E6A, followed by INTBP[channel] lookup
search_methods.tool: tools/toyota decomp source 0x62e6a plus raw little-endian INTBP reads
search_methods.exact_query: tools/toyota decomp source 0x62e6a; select EIC stores whose written halfword & 0x0080 == 0; read u32(CodeFlash, 0x20200 + channel*4)

search_methods.claim: Eight startup-enabled ISR entries are not functions; channel 8 and the masked/polled EIC136 vector are recovered functions.
search_methods.pattern: exact INTBP targets for the nine startup-unmasked channels plus EIC136, joined to function-entry records
search_methods.exact_query: read u32(CodeFlash, 0x20200 + channel*4) for channels 8,133,134,135,136,187,188,292,293,379; exact-match each target against inventory records whose record == function

search_methods.claim: Configured signal rows with no payload bit source retain the bounded no-extraction classification from the application-RX census.
search_methods.pattern: configured RX signal-to-PDU rows joined to literal generated bitfield/group extraction call sites and table-driven extractor rows

variant_record.why: Execution-aware fuzzing and dataflow review need the real foreground and interrupt entry set rather than a single main function.
variant_record.cross_variant_evidence: Sienna data/scheduler_periods.csv establishes the TAUJ constant-to-period convention. Addresses, EIC channels, timer constants, receive rules, and consumers here are decoded again from the exact Camry image; no Sienna address or signal mapping is transferred.
